detailSections.bodyEn: Graduate with an Australian degree and the skills, knowledge and their application that validate the BEC program learning outcomes listed here.

On successful completion of SP Jain's BEC, you graduate with an Australian undergraduate degree and the skills, knowledge and their application that validate the following learning outcomes: 1. Knowledge Acquire a sound and in-depth knowledge of the theory and scholarly literature in the discipline of Economics Integrate theoretical and technical aspects of Economics, which include Macroeconomics and Microeconomics, Quantitative Methods, Econometrics, Monetary Economics, Behavioural Finance and Economics 2. Skills Analyse economic data and events from primary and secondary sources and provide critical analysis and possible solutions using both quantitative and interpretive analysis Professionally practice and excel in research relevant to the area of work 3. Application of Knowledge and Skills Identify economic issues in the environment, exercise judgment and provide solution options with respect to individual, social and regulatory factors Critically apply theoretical and technical economic knowledge and skills to present and communicate economic events and trends in a coherent way to suitable audiences, which include corporations, investors, statutory bodies and policy makers Reflect on performance feedback to identify action learning opportunities and self-improvements --> --> Make an Enquiry Make an Enquiry TOLL-FREE NUMBER: 1800-212-1827 Get a Brochure --> Attend a Session --> Apply Now Chat MBA OPEN DAYS & Profile Evaluation Days Register Here ABOUT US Heritage Vision & Values Recognition Leadership Board of Directors Accreditations & Registrations Institutional Policies Privacy Policy EXPLORE Global Learning News Events SP Jain Blog Undergraduate Updates Alumni Careers Global Agents CAMPUS Mumbai Dubai Singapore Sydney CONTACT US SP Jain School of Global Management, Singapore Campus 10 Hyderabad Road, Next to HortPark, off Alexandra Road, Singapore, 119579 Call: +65 6270 4748 Email: admissionssg@spjain.org registrar@spjain.org Chat with a Student Ambassador --> --> SP JAIN GLOBAL INSIGHTS --> © 2025 S P Jain School of Global Management S P Jain School of Global Management Pty.
